findings.description: An earlier stop/error can enter frozen dispatch_jobs drain_processes while the owner work_alarm remains armed. SIGALRM arriving during this finally can interrupt confirmed cleanup; dispatch_owned/run currently have no independent owned-process cleanup reference. The retained lease and worker expiry prevent an approved overlapping continuation and bound worker work, but do not prove this owner reaped every child before returning.
findings.requested_regression: Deliver owner work alarm while an inert child is in exceptional drain; prove every started child is confirmed reaped before lease release, or retain lease if still unconfirmed.

findings.description: process_observation returns None when /proc cannot report self or an owned child. observe maps self None and absent/mismatched child identities to zero RSS. This can report a planning-envelope pass without observing the live owned process.
findings.requested_regression: Use only self and owned inert children. Require observable RSS or explicit unknown/fail-stop for still-live ownership; exclude only known terminated/reaped workers. Never probe unrelated PIDs.

nonblocking_observations: Exact archive/member inventory, actual archive session exit, full source/runtime/protocol and fixed-eight-seed identities are required before new working-copy continuation.
The copied archive is regular independent files, not symlink/hardlink aliases to original evidence. Old 100k settings/RNG/checkpoint/full observation prefix are inspected exactly.
Only the unchanged one_seed entrypoint can produce the next registered 300000 prefix. Global completion requires all eight 305000-total-sweep checkpoints and matching 300000 stage receipts.
New output and per-seed once claims prevent silent retry; root still separately authorizes resource adoption.
Historical other_prospective_water_reservation_bytes is a forecast; actual admission must use root-bound remaining water and P256 bytes plus the one shared 4 GiB reserve.
scope: Read-only source, policy and inert-test review. No archive extraction, raw checkpoint decoding, PES calls, scientific RNG, simulation, source edits or test execution.
